verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a public API of over 2,500 endpoints that explicitly covers Workers. It is reachable with scoped API tokens or OAuth, a probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json, and the official MCP server exposes the same API to agents. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving Workers through the REST API, and Workers-specific API reference detail in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: provides access to the entire Cloudflare API — over 2,500 endpoints across DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust, and every other product — through just two tools: search() and execute()
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
For CI/CD or automation, you can create a Cloudflare API token with the permissions you need and pass it as a bearer token in the Authorization header.
